agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has two massive bodies (1 ~17.7, 2 ~17.9) on colliding trajectories. By step 24 they are 1.13 apart, step 25 0.72, step 26 0.336 (close_pairs). Despite softening 0.3, leapfrog with dt ~0.026 and only 6 substeps cannot resolve the rapidly varying acceleration during the close approach, causing large energy jump: energy goes from ~86-102 to -47 (change 126.9 > allowed 108.3). Halving dt restores conservation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
